fields.description: 8-byte ASCII save magic 'LEGO2010'. Read by FUN_0803f9a8 via FUN_08011a64(0,0x10) which loads the 16-byte header, then compares these 8 bytes (iVar3<8 loop vs ROM template at iRam0803f9fc/iRam0803fa00). Rebuilt by FUN_0803fea4 via FUN_08031828 template copy and stored with FUN_08011acc(0,0x10).
fields.evidence: FUN_0803f9a8 reads header with FUN_08011a64(0,0x10) and 8-byte magic compare loop; FUN_0803fea4 rebuilds header and writes with FUN_08011acc(0,0x10); low-level EEPROM bit-bang FUN_0804becc/FUN_0804bf90 via FUN_0804be4c and DMA3.
